## Description

Uses rapid improvement in advance-decline breadth, percent of stocks above moving averages or new-high/new-low statistics as a broad risk-on signal.

## Where it may fit

Broad participation in recoveries or breakouts; less reliable when breadth data is incomplete or concentrated mega-caps dominate the index.

## Vehicles

Equity index ETFs, tactical equity allocation and market timing overlays.

## Required data

Point-in-time constituent universe, advances/declines, highs/lows, constituent prices and index data.

## Caveats

Breadth definitions and universe membership materially change the signal; it is an exposure filter, not necessarily a standalone alpha source.
